summary: Launch a job template with curl by POSTing to /api/v2/job_templates/<id>/launch/ with basic auth and Content-Type application/json; the JSON response contains the job ID to poll.
questions: How do I launch a job with curl?
API call to launch a job template

answer_card.title: Launch a job template with curl
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
curl -f -k -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -XPOST \
  --user admin:awxsecret \
  https://<controller>/api/v2/job_templates/1/launch/
```
Parse the returned JSON for the job `id` and poll `/api/v2/jobs/<id>/`.
